EC1: 1. Smokers of more than 10 cigarettes a day.
EC2: 2. Patients who have received periodontal treatment in the previous 12 months.
EC3: 3. Patients who have used antibiotics in the last 6 months.
EC4: 4. Routine use of oral antiseptics and / or during the previous 3 months.
EC5: 5. Systemic conditions that required antibiotic premedication.
EC7: 7. Medications that could influence the outcome of periodontal therapy.
EC8: 8. Any known allergies to the test antimicrobial agents.
